name: NORTHERN STATE UNIVERSITY GRID MARKET - SODEXO

violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. The rice scoop was stored in a dish of water.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. The lids for the plastic cups by the boba chillers machine were not inverted. Foam containers on the food line were not inverted.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. A wet mop was being stored in the bottom of the mop sink and not in a position to dry.
